title: Repeated Returned Payments — LandlordGuard Return-Frequency Multiplier
content:
**Rule.** On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy the return-frequency factor of a returned-payment fee depends on the returned payments posted on the policy in the 12 calendar months up to the charge date, this one included: three or more multiply the fee by 2; exactly two multiply it by 1.5; one leaves it as it stands.

The return-frequency factor multiplies the fee as a whole, the returned-fee basis together with the returned-fee adjustment, before the fee is rounded.

| Returned payments posted on the policy, 12 calendar months up to the charge date, this one included | Return-frequency factor |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | multiplied by 2 |
| exactly 2 | multiplied by 1.5 |
| 1 (this one only) | as it stands |

## Hypothetical cases

| Returned payments in the window, counting this one | A fee of 30.00 USD before the multiplier becomes |
|---|---|
| this one, and others 3 and 9 months earlier | 60.00 USD |
| this one, and another 11 months earlier | 45.00 USD |
| this one, and another 14 months earlier | 30.00 USD |
